set -euo pipefail

buildifier="${1:-}"
workspace_root="${2:-${BUILD_WORKSPACE_DIRECTORY:-$PWD}}"

if [[ -z "$buildifier" ]]; then
  if [[ -z "${RUNFILES_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    RUNFILES_DIR="${0}.runfiles"
  fi
  buildifier="$(find "$RUNFILES_DIR" -type f -name buildifier -perm -u+x | head -n1)"
fi

if [[ -z "$buildifier" || ! -x "$buildifier" ]]; then
  echo "buildifier executable not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

mapfile -t files < <(find "$workspace_root" \
  \( -name BUILD -o -name BUILD.bazel -o -name '*.bzl' -o -name MODULE.bazel -o -name WORKSPACE -o -name WORKSPACE.bazel \) \
  -not -path "$workspace_root/bazel-*" \
  -not -path "$workspace_root/.git/*" \
  -not -path "$workspace_root/tools/lint/buildifier/testdata/*" \
  | sort)

if [[ ${#files[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "No buildifier-relevant files found under $workspace_root" >&2
  exit 0
fi

output_file="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$output_file"' EXIT

set +e
"$buildifier" -mode=check -lint=warn -warnings=unused-variable "${files[@]}" >"$output_file" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e

if [[ $status -ne 0 ]]; then
  cat "$output_file" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if [[ -s "$output_file" ]]; then
  cat "$output_file" >&2
  echo "buildifier lint warnings found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# *******************************************************************************

set -euo pipefail

if [[ -z "${RUNFILES_DIR:-}" ]]; then
  RUNFILES_DIR="${0}.runfiles"
fi

buildifier="$(find "$RUNFILES_DIR" -type f -name buildifier -perm -u+x | head -n1)"
wrapper="$(find "$RUNFILES_DIR" -type f -name buildifier_lint.sh | head -n1)"
fixture="$(find "$RUNFILES_DIR" -type f -path '*unused_cc_test_load/BUILD' | head -n1)"

if [[ -z "$buildifier" || -z "$wrapper" || -z "$fixture" ]]; then
  echo "Required test inputs not found in runfiles" >&2
  exit 1
fi

tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$tmpdir/pkg"
cp "$fixture" "$tmpdir/pkg/BUILD"

set +e
output="$("$wrapper" "$buildifier" "$tmpdir" 2>&1)"
status=$?
set -e

if [[ $status -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo "Expected buildifier lint to fail on unused cc_test load" >&2
  echo "$output" >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! grep -q "unused variable" <<<"$output"; then
  echo "Expected unused variable warning for cc_test load" >&2
  echo "$output" >&2
  exit 1
fi

load("@rules_shell//shell:sh_binary.bzl", "sh_binary")
load("@rules_shell//shell:sh_test.bzl", "sh_test")

package(default_visibility = ["//visibility:public"])

sh_binary(
    name = "buildifier_lint",
    srcs = ["buildifier_lint.sh"],
    data = ["@buildifier_prebuilt//:buildifier"],
    tags = ["no-sandbox"],
    target_compatible_with = ["@platforms//os:linux"],
)

filegroup(
    name = "unused_cc_test_load_fixture",
    srcs = ["testdata/unused_cc_test_load/BUILD"],
)

sh_test(
    name = "buildifier_lint_test",
    srcs = ["buildifier_lint_test.sh"],
    data = [
        ":buildifier_lint.sh",
        ":unused_cc_test_load_fixture",
        "@buildifier_prebuilt//:buildifier",
    ],
    tags = ["no-sandbox"],
    target_compatible_with = ["@platforms//os:linux"],
)

cc_library(
    name = "fixture",
    srcs = ["fixture.cc"],
)
